Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B.

Start at ooy: the pair (ooy, eut) comes first; its second item is eut, so the next pair is the one whose first item is eut: (eut, unknown).

The unknown pair's first item is eut, but eut never appears as a first item - so eut is the dangling end of the chain.

Since eut is the dangling end, there are no more pairs to add to the chain.
